text:
Not with jewels

from Morlock Jewelers


nor with perfumes

from Dreyfus


nor with orchids

inside their

music box


nor with a Cadillac


but only

with my poems

did I win her


And she prefers me,

though I am poor,

to all of


Somoza's millions

translation.title: Not with Jewels
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the catalog of luxury gifts displaced by poems and poverty.
